text: 中央财政史上首次！“房贷贴息”节前落地：首套、120平方米以下、150万元以内可享。 美伊“信息混战”：伊朗外长押注”周二答复”，特朗普否认制裁减免。 英伟达、Anthropic首席执行官等周二将出席特朗普午餐会，探讨人工智能风险。 澳洲联储如期加息25基点至4.35%，警告通胀上行风险显现、不排除进一步收紧。 日本40年期国债拍卖认购倍数创2020年以来新高。 韩国拟在收益率飙升情况下启动紧急债券回购。 Anthropic递交招股书：去年亏损420亿美元，收入增长12倍至46亿美元，风险部分警告“威胁人类生存”。 OpenAI重启200美元Pro订阅，
text_en: First time in central fiscal history! "Mortgage interest subsidies" land before the holiday: available for first homes, under 120 square meters, and within 1.5 million yuan. U.S.-Iran "information battle": Iran's foreign minister bets on a "Tuesday reply," Trump denies sanctions relief. Nvidia, Anthropic CEO and others will attend Trump's lunch on Tuesday to discuss AI risks. The Reserve Bank of Australia raised rates by 25 basis points to 4.35% as expected, warning that upside inflation risks have emerged and not ruling out further tightening. Japan's 40-year government bond auction bid-to-cover ratio hit a new high since 2020. South Korea plans emergency bond buybacks amid soaring yields. Anthropic files prospectus: lost 42 billion U.S. dollars last year, revenue grew 12-fold to 4.6 billion U.S. dollars, risk section warns of "threat to human survival." OpenAI restarts the 200 U.S. dollar Pro subscription,
